metadata.description: Drive your Synek timeline canvas from Claude Code.

plugins.name: synek
plugins.description: Talk to Claude on the left, watch your Synek timeline build itself on the right. Bundles the MCP connection plus the know-how, with /synek:map (build a timeline), /synek:story (tell an immersive cited story), /synek:watch (keep ongoing timelines current), /synek:follow (a scheduled keeper-chapter loop), /synek:next-chapter (serialized stories), /synek:brand-story (on-brand via Realscript), and /synek:setup.
